rule_or_pattern: drop lines flagged C:repeated_word (doubled readings); do NOT apply the column-crossing/merge drop to this book: it is single-column and its 'crossing' lines are correct full-width lines
notes: 1868 diplomatic documents, single wide column. Most lines match the print, including the full-width lines flagged D:column_crossing/merge (6, 23, 25, 29, 34, 35, 37, 40), which are continuous text, not merged columns, so the pool-wide gutter rule would wrongly discard them. Genuine errors: C:repeated_word lines double words and fragments (21 'πιβαρύνουσι πρὸ πρὸ τριῶν τριῶν ... τῆς τῆς'; 24 'τος ... τὸ τὴν ... ὅπως ὅπως ... ἐπανάστασ ἐπανάστασιν'). Smaller slips: breathings dropped on some initial capitals ('Η' for Ἡ in 2 and 15, 'Υπουργός' in 19, 'Ελιοτ' in 34), and 31 misreads italic 'Μετάφρασις' as 'Μετάγεασις'.
